rules.title: Residential Rental Property Application Fee Cap
rules.effectiveDateQuote: This act shall take effect on the first day of the fourth month next following the date of enactment
rules.requirement: A landlord or agent cannot charge an application or similar fee to apply to lease or sublease residential rental property that exceeds $50. The cap is adjusted annually by the Consumer Price Index.
rules.quotedSpan: A landlord, or agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which exceeds $50.
rules.coverageDescription: All residential rental properties except one-family or two-family dwellings offered for rent.
exemptions: One-family or two-family dwelling offered for rent
Real estate licensees unless the licensee is the landlord
warnings: Enactment date stated as January 20, 2026; effective date computed as first day of fourth month following (May 1, 2026)
Statute authorizes annual CPI adjustment beginning January 1 of the year following enactment; the $50 base cap applies until the first adjustment
